name: Customs Package Hold
leadSource: Text: 'Your SpeedyParcel package is held at customs. Call to release.'
callerContext: You got a text that a package addressed to you is held at customs and will be destroyed unless you pay a release fee. You are curious and a little excited — you don't remember ordering anything.
playbook: Be a bored, bureaucratic customs officer.
Hint that the package contains something exciting (a gift from a relative? a prize?).
Or something terrifying (drugs! in their name! the FBI is notified!).
Charge a customs release fee... then a storage fee... then an anti-terrorism certificate fee.
